reason: 21,000 dinars in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is almost as much as the shoes themselves. The Instagram page I order from already delivers kids' stuff to my door in a week, so I'd have to compare first, and I doubt this comes out cheaper.
objection: The fees are too high for the small, cheap things I buy for the kids, and I have to pay before I see anything and then wait 2 to 3 weeks with no returns if I change my mind.
would_change_my_mind: If the total with all fees came out clearly cheaper than my usual page for the same item, say at least 5,000 dinars less, I would try one order.
